products.name: OneTrust AI Governance
products.note: Privacy-first approach; strong data governance; compliance automation; good for privacy-primary orgs

profile_text.body:
OneTrust is an Atlanta, Georgia-based company founded in 2016 that, according to its own site, helps organizations manage privacy, consent, and AI governance while automating compliance and reducing risk. The company describes its core offering as the OneTrust AI-Ready Governance Platform, which it characterizes as a continuous system connecting privacy, data, AI, and technology risk in one place, allowing organizations to define purpose, automate assessments, enforce controls, and monitor risks across domains.

OneTrust's primary AI product is OneTrust AI Governance, catalogued in the AI Governance and Risk Management Platforms category. The site presents the platform as embedding governance into data and AI workflows and providing a continuous, real-time view of how data and AI are used. The company positions itself as particularly suited to organizations with a privacy-first orientation, emphasizing compliance automation and data governance alongside AI risk management.

The held facts associate OneTrust with 48 legal matters in the state of Georgia, though no specific case details are recorded in the available data. The company has a verified profile on this site as of August 30, 2026, and no MCP server registrations or SEC filings are noted in the held facts.
